description: This Java class implements the OrderSetService interface for managing order sets within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for saving, retiring, and retrieving order sets and related attribute types, integrating with database access objects and handling transaction management.

classes.name: OrderSetServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the OrderSetService interface, providing core operations for managing order sets, including save, retire, unretire, and retrieval methods, with transaction support.

methods.name: setOrderSetDAO
methods.description: Assigns the data access object (DAO) responsible for database operations related to order sets.

methods.name: saveOrderSet
methods.description: Saves an OrderSet object to the database, handling persistence logic.

methods.name: retireOrderSet
methods.description: Marks an OrderSet as retired, with a provided retire reason, and updates related members.

methods.name: unretireOrderSet
methods.description: Reverts the retirement status of an OrderSet.

methods.name: saveOrderSetInternal
methods.description: Internal synchronized method to persist an OrderSet, ensuring proper handling of members and attributes.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderSets, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Fetches an OrderSet by its internal ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSet using its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetMember by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: retireOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Marks an OrderSetAttributeType as retired, with a reason.

methods.name: unretireOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Reverts the retirement of an OrderSetAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderSetAttributeType from the database.
